text:
Maya K: Heads-up: planning public announcement for Adaptive Routing on Mar 25 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs preview, canary window, and a 2-sentence benchmark summary for the blog. Also confirm webinar landing page + inbound lead routing. @Jon P @Sophie L?

Jon P: Docs PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-routing. Canary plan: Mar 25 08:30 PT start at 10% in us-west-2; 50% at 09:15; full at 10:00. Will post deploy note to #eng-oncall at kickoff.

Sophie L: Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/blob/main/2026-03-25-adaptive-routing.md. Waiting on final infra benches to finalize blog copy. Webinar page draft: https://marketing.redwood.ai/webinars/adaptive-routing (needs CTA). I'll own enterprise lead routing if eng provides the webhook schema.

Tom R: Bench highlights: long-context tests on p4d met targets. Gist: https://gist.github.com/tom/abcd. Not including quantized variant in canary; will follow after. Note: KV cache warming causes cold-start spikes  add callout in docs.

Maya K: Can you post a 2-sentence blurb for the blog by EOD?

Jon P: Blurb: "Adaptive Routing cuts median token latency by ~22% and reduces infra cost by ~18% on common chat workloads by routing short requests to cached pools and long requests to high-throughput instances." Posting alt phrasing in ~30m.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout 1768812000 initiated by @jonp  status: queued.

Tom R: Detailed numbers in gist: median 27ms -> 21ms, p95 450ms -> 360ms, cost/unit 1.00 -> 0.82. Added KV cache doc snippet recommendation.

Maya K: Good. Marketing will use staging docs + changelog. Sophie  please set up Zapier webhook for inbound leads and share mapping.

Sophie L: On it. Need event schema + sample payload. @Jon P can you paste the fields?

Jon P: Schema fields: customer_email, org_name, tier, trial_requested, region, feature_flags. Will DM webhook URL and sample payload.

Maya K: One more - rollback plan if canary errors spike? @Tom R

Tom R: Auto-rollback: if error rate >25% for 5m revert to previous routing. Manual abort via console. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-rollback.

Maya K: Marketing will schedule blog Mar 25 09:15 PT (short delay), social 09:30 PT, webinar Apr 2 10:00 PT. I'll drop final copy here. :rocket: 

Jon P: I'll post the deploy note when canary starts.

Sophie L: Will confirm Zapier wiring once done.

Tom R: Monitoring metrics and I'll update #eng-oncall.
